channel.title: Pointless Celebrities
channel.desc: A special sports edition of the general knowledge quiz in which four teams try to come up with the answers that no-one else could think of. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and co-host Richard Osman. Featuring Vanessa Bauer, Beth Tweddle MBE, Anita Asante, William Bayley MBE, Jack Laugher MBE, Ellie Robinson MBE, Sarah Hunter MBE and Ugo Monye.
